+# 工程图出详图默认选项（分支实现）
+
+范围只包含文档属性 → 出详图 → 新建视图时自动插入：零件孔中心标记、零件圆角中心标记。只操作文档级默认 Toggle，不创建视图、中心标记或实体；不修改总体绘图标准、字体、公差。其他字段不在支持范围。
+
+官方映射：[Document Properties > Detailing](https://help.solidworks.com/2024/english/api/swconst/DP_Detailing.htm)。字段为 `auto_center_marks.part_holes` / `auto_center_marks.part_fillets`，分别使用 `swDetailingAutoInsertCenterMarksForHoles` / `swDetailingAutoInsertCenterMarksForFillets`，通过 `IModelDocExtension.Get/SetUserPreferenceToggle`，option 为 `swDetailingNoOptionSpecified`。枚举数值从当前宿主安装旁的官方 `swconst.tlb` 读取，不猜数值，不调用应用级 preference setter。
+
+[GetExecutablePath](https://help.solidworks.com/2024/english/api/sldworksapi/solidworks.interop.sldworks~solidworks.interop.sldworks.isldworks~getexecutablepath.html) 用于定位安装目录；常量库缺失或不完整时拒绝操作。
+[SetUserPreferenceToggle](https://help.solidworks.com/2025/english/api/sldworksapi/SOLIDWORKS.Interop.sldworks~SOLIDWORKS.Interop.sldworks.IModelDocExtension~SetUserPreferenceToggle.html) 对 false 返回的说明存在歧义。实现保留返回值，要求原生成功返回 True 和完整读回一致；失败不重试。
+
+```sh
+swcli document detailing-options --document d-ab12cd --json
+swcli document detailing-option-set auto_center_marks.part_holes true \
+  --if-options '{"auto_center_marks.part_holes":false,"auto_center_marks.part_fillets":true}' \
+  --document d-ab12cd --if-update-stamp 7 --lease l-ab12cd34ef56 --json
+```
+
+写入必须给出明确文档、版本戳、有效 lease 与完整两个布尔旧值的 CAS。单字段写入同时校验另一个字段不变。文档必须可写并处于普通图纸编辑状态；拒绝图纸格式编辑、活动模型视图或外来/缺失草图。读取可保留其他编辑模式；读前后检查上下文、文档身份、dirty/stamp 与前台目标，后台操作不激活目标。变更后最多标 dirty 一次，最终观察不得悄悄修复状态漂移。
+
+返回 `mutation.attempted` / `may_have_changed`；原生 setter 已尝试后即使失败也必须保留可能部分变更的回执。不会自动回滚、重复 setter 或重启宿主。相同值为无 mutation 的成功 no-op。
+

+"""Run one owned calibration process, bounded to 600s per traced call and 1800s total."""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+
+def timeout_reason(started, now, records):
+    if now - started > 1800:
+        return "calibration exceeded the 1800-second group budget"
+    # Each harness boundary encloses its native calls. Limiting the whole
+    # boundary to 600s also bounds every individual nested native call.
+    pending = {}
+    for record in records:
+        name = record.get("call")
+        if record.get("phase") == "begin":
+            pending[name] = record["time"]
+        elif record.get("phase") in ("end", "error"):
+            pending.pop(name, None)
+    if any(now - began > 600 for began in pending.values()):
+        return "native calibration call exceeded the 600-second budget"
+    # Some registry/state probes sit between named harness boundaries. They
+    # must not inherit the longer group budget if a COM call hangs there.
+    latest_boundary = max((record.get("time", started) for record in records), default=started)
+    if now - latest_boundary > 600:
+        return "untraced calibration work exceeded the 600-second budget"
+    return None
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--public-gate", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--swconst", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--drawing-template", required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    args.output_dir.mkdir()
+    evidence = args.output_dir / ("public" if args.public_gate else "calibration")
+    verifier = "verify-detailing-public.py" if args.public_gate else "verify-detailing-calibration.py"
+    command = [sys.executable, "-I", str(Path(__file__).with_name(verifier)),
+               "--output-dir", str(evidence), "--drawing-template", args.drawing_template]
+    if not args.public_gate:
+        command += ["--swconst", args.swconst]
+    started = time.time()
+    receipt = dict(schema_version=1, source_commit=os.environ.get("GITHUB_SHA"),
+                   public_acceptance=args.public_gate, native_timeout_seconds=600, group_timeout_seconds=1800)
+    with (args.output_dir / "stdout.log").open("wb") as stdout, (args.output_dir / "stderr.log").open("wb") as stderr:
+        process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=stdout, stderr=stderr)
+        receipt["process_id"] = process.pid
+        while process.poll() is None:
+            records = []
+            trace = evidence / "trace.jsonl"
+            if trace.exists():
+                for line in trace.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
+                    try:
+                        row = json.loads(line)
+                        if "time" not in row and "monotonic_seconds" in row:
+                            row["time"] = row["monotonic_seconds"] + time.time() - time.monotonic()
+                        if "call" in row and "phase" in row:
+                            records.append(row)
+                    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                        pass  # Ignore only an in-progress final line.
+            reason = timeout_reason(started, time.time(), records)
+            if reason:
+                receipt["failure"] = reason
+                (args.output_dir / "watchdog.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
+                subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", str(process.pid), "/T", "/F"], check=False,
+                               stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
+                process.wait(timeout=30)
+                break
+            time.sleep(1)
+    receipt.update(returncode=process.returncode, elapsed_seconds=time.time() - started)
+    receipt["success"] = process.returncode == 0 and "failure" not in receipt
+    (args.output_dir / "watchdog.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
+    return 0 if receipt["success"] else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+            if isinstance(row, dict) and row.get("event") == "swcli.native-call" and row.get("request_id") == request_id:
+                records.append(row)
+        require(len(records) >= 2 and records[0].get("phase") == "begin"
+                and records[-1].get("phase") in (("end", "error") if refused else ("end",))
+                and records[0].get("sequence") == records[-1].get("sequence") == 0
+                and records[0].get("call") == records[-1].get("call") == operation,
+                "native operation trace is incomplete")
+        require(all(row.get("operation") == operation and (row.get("phase") != "error" or refused and row.get("sequence") == 0) for row in records),
+                "native operation trace changed operation or recorded an error")

+        require(type(worker) is int and worker > 0 and all(row.get("worker_pid") == worker for row in records),
+                "native trace lacks one owning worker")

+        self.worker = worker
+        begins = Counter((row["sequence"], row["call"]) for row in records if row["phase"] == "begin")

+        calls = records[1:-1]
+        require(len(calls) % 2 == 0, "native trace has an incomplete pair")
+        for sequence, (begin, end) in enumerate(zip(calls[::2], calls[1::2]), 1):
+            require(begin["sequence"] == end["sequence"] == sequence and begin["phase"] == "begin"
+                    and end["phase"] == "end" and begin["call"] == end["call"], "native trace ordering is invalid")
+            require(0 <= end["monotonic_seconds"] - begin["monotonic_seconds"] <= 600,
